aez_belt.licence: national data; internal use (owner to confirm)
aez_belt.citation: Ministry of Agriculture, Ethiopia. Agro-ecological belts of Ethiopia (15 belts).
aez_belt.resampling: rasterize (cell centre; outer rings only, as the legacy stack)
aez_belt.method: burn OBJECTID of every polygon's outer rings in file order (the legacy rasterization; holes are not honoured, see geodata_v2.md)
aez_belt.notes: outer rings only (legacy rule); a hole-aware rasterization differs on 93119 cells

precip_annual.licence: WorldClim 2.1 terms (free for research and non-commercial use; owner to confirm)
precip_annual.citation: Fick, S.E. and Hijmans, R.J. (2017) WorldClim 2: new 1-km spatial resolution climate surfaces for global land areas. Int. J. Climatol. 37, 4302-4315.
precip_annual.method: sum of the 12 monthly totals at native resolution, then bilinear to the grid (get_precip.py)

temp_mean_annual.licence: WorldClim 2.1 terms (free for research and non-commercial use; owner to confirm)
temp_mean_annual.citation: Fick, S.E. and Hijmans, R.J. (2017) WorldClim 2. Int. J. Climatol. 37, 4302-4315.
temp_mean_annual.method: mean of the 12 monthly means at native resolution, then bilinear (get_temp.py)

precip_seasonality.licence: WorldClim 2.1 terms (free for research and non-commercial use; owner to confirm)
precip_seasonality.citation: Fick, S.E. and Hijmans, R.J. (2017) WorldClim 2: new 1-km spatial resolution climate surfaces for global land areas. Int. J. Climatol. 37, 4302-4315.
precip_seasonality.method: each month bilinear to the grid, then 100 x population SD / mean (get_seasonality.py)

lgp_days.licence: WorldClim 2.1 terms (free for research and non-commercial use; owner to confirm)
lgp_days.citation: Fick, S.E. and Hijmans, R.J. (2017) WorldClim 2: new 1-km spatial resolution climate surfaces for global land areas. Int. J. Climatol. 37, 4302-4315.; Fick, S.E. and Hijmans, R.J. (2017) WorldClim 2. Int. J. Climatol. 37, 4302-4315.
lgp_days.method: Thornthwaite PET; growing month = rain >= 0.5 PET and T > 5 degC; days summed (get_lgp.py)

elevation.licence: Copernicus DEM licence (free, attribution: (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA)
elevation.citation: European Space Agency and Airbus (2022) Copernicus DEM GLO-30. doi:10.5270/ESA-c5d3d65
elevation.method: every tile warped bilinear onto the grid and composited in tile order (get_terrain.py)

slope.licence: Copernicus DEM licence (free, attribution: (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA)
slope.citation: European Space Agency and Airbus (2022) Copernicus DEM GLO-30. doi:10.5270/ESA-c5d3d65
slope.method: latitude-aware np.gradient of the 250 m elevation (get_terrain.py)

soil_clay.citation: Poggio, L. et al. (2021) SoilGrids 2.0: producing soil information for the globe with quantified spatial uncertainty. SOIL 7, 217-240.
soil_clay.method: WarpedVRT bilinear from the public VRT, g/kg / 10 (get_soil.py)

soil_ph.citation: Poggio, L. et al. (2021) SoilGrids 2.0: producing soil information for the globe with quantified spatial uncertainty. SOIL 7, 217-240.

soil_soc.citation: Poggio, L. et al. (2021) SoilGrids 2.0: producing soil information for the globe with quantified spatial uncertainty. SOIL 7, 217-240.

land_cover.citation: Zanaga, D. et al. (2022) ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200. doi:10.5281/zenodo.7254221
land_cover.method: every 3-degree tile warped (mode) onto the grid and composited (get_landcover.py)

slope_length_factor.licence: Copernicus DEM licence (free, attribution: (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA)
slope_length_factor.citation: European Space Agency and Airbus (2022) Copernicus DEM GLO-30. doi:10.5270/ESA-c5d3d65
slope_length_factor.method: Moore and Burch (1986) RUSLE approximation LS = (As/22.13)^0.4 (sin b/0.0896)^1.3; S from 30 m slope averaged to 90 m, As = D8 specific catchment area at 90 m capped at 300 m
slope_length_factor.notes: 30 m slope terms, 3 arc-second D8 routing with WhiteboxTools WhiteboxTools v2.4.0 (c) Dr. John Lindsay 2017-2023 (whitebox 2.3.6): FillDepressions (fix_flats), D8Pointer, D8FlowAccumulation; sea cells (GLO-30 == 0.0) excluded from routing

tpi.licence: Copernicus DEM licence (free, attribution: (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA)
tpi.citation: European Space Agency and Airbus (2022) Copernicus DEM GLO-30. doi:10.5270/ESA-c5d3d65
tpi.method: elevation minus the mean elevation of the surrounding ~1 km square window (11 x 11 cells at 90 m)

twi.licence: Copernicus DEM licence (free, attribution: (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA)
twi.citation: European Space Agency and Airbus (2022) Copernicus DEM GLO-30. doi:10.5270/ESA-c5d3d65
twi.method: ln(a / tan b): a = D8 specific catchment area (m), tan b = mean 30 m slope (floor 0.001)
twi.notes: 30 m slope terms, 3 arc-second D8 routing with WhiteboxTools WhiteboxTools v2.4.0 (c) Dr. John Lindsay 2017-2023 (whitebox 2.3.6): FillDepressions (fix_flats), D8Pointer, D8FlowAccumulation; sea cells (GLO-30 == 0.0) excluded from routing

flow_accumulation.licence: Copernicus DEM licence (free, attribution: (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA)
flow_accumulation.citation: European Space Agency and Airbus (2022) Copernicus DEM GLO-30. doi:10.5270/ESA-c5d3d65
flow_accumulation.method: WhiteboxTools FillDepressions (fix_flats), D8Pointer, D8FlowAccumulation in cells x the cell area of the row (km2)
flow_accumulation.notes: 30 m slope terms, 3 arc-second D8 routing with WhiteboxTools WhiteboxTools v2.4.0 (c) Dr. John Lindsay 2017-2023 (whitebox 2.3.6): FillDepressions (fix_flats), D8Pointer, D8FlowAccumulation; sea cells (GLO-30 == 0.0) excluded from routing

dist_to_stream_m.licence: Copernicus DEM licence (free, attribution: (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA)
dist_to_stream_m.citation: European Space Agency and Airbus (2022) Copernicus DEM GLO-30. doi:10.5270/ESA-c5d3d65
dist_to_stream_m.method: WhiteboxTools ExtractStreams at upstream area >= settings.terrain.stream_threshold_km2, then the Euclidean distance in metres (scipy, latitude-aware cell size)
dist_to_stream_m.notes: streams: WhiteboxTools ExtractStreams at upstream area >= 1.0 km2; Euclidean distance in metres (scipy); 30 m slope terms, 3 arc-second D8 routing with WhiteboxTools WhiteboxTools v2.4.0 (c) Dr. John Lindsay 2017-2023 (whitebox 2.3.6): FillDepressions (fix_flats), D8Pointer, D8FlowAccumulation; sea cells (GLO-30 == 0.0) excluded from routing

soil_sand.citation: Poggio, L. et al. (2021) SoilGrids 2.0: producing soil information for the globe with quantified spatial uncertainty. SOIL 7, 217-240.
soil_sand.method: thickness-weighted mean of 0-5, 5-15, 15-30 cm (5, 10, 15 cm), g/kg / 10

soil_bulk_density.citation: Poggio, L. et al. (2021) SoilGrids 2.0: producing soil information for the globe with quantified spatial uncertainty. SOIL 7, 217-240.
soil_bulk_density.method: thickness-weighted mean of the three depths, cg/cm3 / 100

soil_cec.source_name: SoilGrids v2.0, cation exchange capacity 0-30 cm
soil_cec.citation: Poggio, L. et al. (2021) SoilGrids 2.0: producing soil information for the globe with quantified spatial uncertainty. SOIL 7, 217-240.
soil_cec.method: thickness-weighted mean of the three depths, mmol(c)/kg / 10

soil_nitrogen.citation: Poggio, L. et al. (2021) SoilGrids 2.0: producing soil information for the globe with quantified spatial uncertainty. SOIL 7, 217-240.
soil_nitrogen.method: thickness-weighted mean of the three depths, cg/kg / 100

soil_awc.citation: Poggio, L. et al. (2021) SoilGrids 2.0: producing soil information for the globe with quantified spatial uncertainty. SOIL 7, 217-240.
soil_awc.method: Saxton and Rawls (2006) eqs 1-2 and 6-8 with sand, clay, organic matter (SOC x 1.724) and the SoilGrids bulk density as the density adjustment, 0-30 cm
soil_awc.notes: Saxton and Rawls (2006), 0-30 cm, OM = SOC x 1.724, density factor from bdod

soil_depth_bedrock.citation: Hengl, T. et al. (2017) SoilGrids250m: global gridded soil information based on machine learning. PLoS ONE 12, e0169748. Shangguan, W. et al. (2017) Mapping the global depth to bedrock. JAMES 9, 65-88.
soil_depth_bedrock.method: WarpedVRT bilinear; SoilGrids v2 has no depth-to-bedrock product, so the 2017 product is used and the layer stays optional

rain_mean_1991_2020.licence: CC0 1.0 / public domain (Climate Hazards Center; owner to confirm)
rain_mean_1991_2020.citation: Funk, C. et al. (2015) The climate hazards infrared precipitation with stations, a new environmental record for monitoring extremes. Sci. Data 2, 150066.
rain_mean_1991_2020.method: mean of the 30 annual totals (sum of monthly files), native resolution, then bilinear

rain_cv_interannual.licence: CC0 1.0 / public domain (Climate Hazards Center; owner to confirm)
rain_cv_interannual.citation: Funk, C. et al. (2015) The climate hazards infrared precipitation with stations, a new environmental record for monitoring extremes. Sci. Data 2, 150066.
rain_cv_interannual.method: 100 x sample SD (ddof 1) / mean of the 30 annual totals, then bilinear

dry_season_length_months.licence: CC0 1.0 / public domain (Climate Hazards Center; owner to confirm)
dry_season_length_months.citation: Funk, C. et al. (2015) The climate hazards infrared precipitation with stations, a new environmental record for monitoring extremes. Sci. Data 2, 150066.
dry_season_length_months.resampling: bilinear (monthly climatology), then counted on the grid
dry_season_length_months.method: number of calendar months whose 1991-2020 mean rainfall is below settings.dry_month_mm

pet_hargreaves_annual.licence: WorldClim 2.1 terms (free for research and non-commercial use; owner to confirm); WorldClim 2.1 terms (owner to confirm)
pet_hargreaves_annual.citation: Fick, S.E. and Hijmans, R.J. (2017) WorldClim 2. Int. J. Climatol. 37, 4302-4315.
pet_hargreaves_annual.method: Hargreaves-Samani PET = 0.0023 x 0.408 Ra (Tmean + 17.8) sqrt(Tmax - Tmin) per month (FAO-56 Ra at mid-month), summed
pet_hargreaves_annual.notes: Tmean from the 30 arc-second normals, Tmax - Tmin from the 2.5 arc-minute normals

aridity_index.licence: CC0 1.0 / public domain (Climate Hazards Center; owner to confirm); WorldClim 2.1 terms (free for research and non-commercial use; owner to confirm); WorldClim 2.1 terms (owner to confirm)
aridity_index.citation: Funk, C. et al. (2015) The climate hazards infrared precipitation with stations, a new environmental record for monitoring extremes. Sci. Data 2, 150066.; Fick, S.E. and Hijmans, R.J. (2017) WorldClim 2. Int. J. Climatol. 37, 4302-4315.
aridity_index.notes: CHIRPS 1991-2020 mean / Hargreaves PET from WorldClim 2.1 (1970-2000)

cropland_fraction_1km.citation: Zanaga, D. et al. (2022) ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200. doi:10.5281/zenodo.7254221
cropland_fraction_1km.resampling: block count (27 x 27 pixels = one grid cell), then a 1 km box
cropland_fraction_1km.method: share of 10 m cropland pixels (class 40) among valid pixels in a 1 km box centred on the cell (weights 0.5,1,1,1,0.5 per axis)
cropland_fraction_1km.notes: box weights per axis [0.5, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.5] (cells of 0.00225 degrees)

travel_time_to_city_min.method: travel time to the nearest city of 50,000 or more, WCS clip then bilinear
